title: Geography
description: Geographical coverage of a pathway. 'global' marks whole-world coverage (a literal flag, not a list of every country); 'regions' maps an author-defined region label, kept as named in the source publication, to the two or more ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country codes it contains; 'country' lists standalone ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country codes. One country code is always a country: a place the publication names for a single country (e.g. 'Japan') is that country's code in 'country', never a one-member region.

global.description: True if the pathway covers the entire world.

regions.description: Map from an author-defined region label (as named in the publication) to the ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country codes in that region. Every region has at least two members: a single country belongs in 'country', and a region with no members matches nothing.

country.description: Standalone ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country codes covered by the pathway.
